exposure: preeclampsia with or without severe features
outcome: successful vaginal delivery after induction of labor
cohort: 1842 women undergoing induction of labor occurring at Grady Memorial Hospital in Atlanta, Georgia from 2016 to 2018
finding: While patients with certain hypertensive diagnoses may be at increased risk for cesarean delivery following IOL, most patients with hypertensive disorders were still able to undergo a successful vaginal delivery following IOL.
